check: KGP event projection/replay, PostgreSQL restart reconnect, and durable lease recovery after worker crash
database_network: default bridge; outbound calls are not used
schema_migration_mode: ordered validated repository schema sources; one transaction per file
limitations: All 393 current ordered PostgreSQL schema migrations were applied, but the deployment, cursor, and prelinked guild rows are synthetic; no seed data or candidate/legacy database was used.
Live Web3/RPC was not used. One synthetic GuildCreated log was supplied to the real indexer, and the Web3 block height was stubbed for the worker recovery phase.
The canonical log was replayed after rewinding the disposable cursor; the idempotency key retained one chain-event row and one projected guild row.
The PostgreSQL container had no volume and published only a loopback port. The default bridge permits egress, but this check makes no external provider or chain calls.
